description: This file defines the GatewayEndpointID utility with functions to generate stable identifiers and pretty descriptions for network endpoints, specifically handling service endpoints and normalization of service names.

methods.name: GatewayEndpointID.stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string ID for an NWEndpoint, handling service endpoints specially by combining type, domain, and normalized name.

methods.name: GatewayEndpointID.prettyDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of an NWEndpoint, decoding any special escape sequences.

methods.name: GatewayEndpointID.normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Decodes a service name and normalizes whitespace characters for use in identifiers.
